2. Method and equations
Global equilibrium: K u = F. Element stiffness and consistent mechanical load vectors are assembled before support
constraints. Reactions follow R = K u - F.
Plate: D = E h³ / [12(1 - nu²)]. Element stiffness K_e = integral(B_b^T D B_b + B_s^T D_s B_s) dA; D_s = (5/6) G h.
Four-node rectangular MITC shear interpolation at edge midpoints; 2 x 2 Gauss integration.
Beam: cubic Hermite Euler-Bernoulli bending; EI is constant. Exact uniform-load interior recovery is included. Analytical
validation uses w_max = 5 q L4/(384 EI) for pin/roller, q L4/(384 EI) for fixed/fixed and q L4/(8 EI) for a cantilever.
Thermal initial curvature: kappa_T = alpha (T_top - T_bottom)/h. It enters the equivalent thermal load and is subtracted from
curvature when recovering moments. Uniform free strain = alpha DeltaT; free DeltaV = V[(1 + alpha DeltaT)³ - 1].

Scope and references
Linear elastic, small displacement, isotropic homogeneous material; entered E is used unchanged.
Service and already-factored ultimate loads are separate totals including self-weight; no load combination is inferred.
Beam: Euler-Bernoulli. Plate: rectangular MITC4 bending/shear; no membrane or solid DOFs.
No RC cracking, creep, shrinkage, reinforcement design, soil springs, contact, buckling, connections or AS 3600/AS 4100
design approval.
Simply supported plate edge: w and tangential slope fixed; clamped edge: all three plate DOFs fixed.
Moments are element-centre values; mesh convergence and local support/load concentrations need review.
Uniform temperature changes volume freely. Plate membrane restraint and thermal cracking stress are not calculated.
MITC shear interpolation: Ko, Lee and Bathe (2017), The MITC4+ shell element in geometric nonlinear analysis, equation
(19). Only the linear rectangular plate-bending/shear construction is used here; the full shell formulation is not implemented.
https://web.mit.edu/kjb/www/Principal_Publications/The_MITC4%2B_shell_element_in_geometric_nonlinear_analysis.pdf
